title: fsl_glm
description: Simple GLM allowing temporal or spatial regression on either text data or images

input_file.description: Input file name (text matrix or 3D/4D image file)
input_file.title: Input file

design_matrix.description: File name of the GLM design matrix (text time courses for temporal regression or an image file for spatial regression)
design_matrix.title: Design matrix

output_file.description: Output file name for GLM parameter estimates (GLM betas)
output_file.title: Output file

mask_file.description: Mask image file name if input is image
mask_file.title: Mask file

design_norm_flag.description: Switch on normalisation of the design matrix columns to unit std. deviation
design_norm_flag.title: Design normalisation flag

data_norm_flag.description: Switch on normalisation of the data time series to unit std. deviation
data_norm_flag.title: Data normalisation flag

demean_flag.description: Switch on de-meaning of design and data
demean_flag.title: De-mean flag

output_copes.description: Output file name for COPEs (either as text file or image)
output_copes.title: Output COPEs file

output_zstats.description: Output file name for Z-stats (either as text file or image)
output_zstats.title: Output Z-stats file

output_tstats.description: Output file name for t-stats (either as text file or image)
output_tstats.title: Output t-stats file

output_pvals.description: Output file name for p-values of Z-stats (either as text file or image)
output_pvals.title: Output p-values file

output_fvals.description: Output file name for F-value of full model fit
output_fvals.title: Output F-value file

output_pfvals.description: Output file name for p-value for full model fit
output_pfvals.title: Output p-value file

output_varcb.description: Output file name for variance of COPEs
output_varcb.title: Output variance of COPEs file

output_sigsq.description: Output file name for residual noise variance sigma-square
output_sigsq.title: Output sigma-square variance file

output_data.description: Output file name for pre-processed data
output_data.title: Output pre-processed data

output_vnscales.description: Output file name for scaling factors for variance normalisation
output_vnscales.title: Output variance normalisation scales file

vx_text.description: List of text files containing text matrix confounds. Caution, BETA option.
vx_text.title: VXT confounds

vx_images.description: List of 4D images containing voxelwise confounds. Caution, BETA option.
vx_images.title: VXF confounds
